about: Gold retrieval set over three synthetic courses: biology (tests/fixtures/rag/biology_*.pdf, the default when 'course' is absent), statistics (tests/fixtures/statistics_module_4.pdf) and chemistry (tests/fixtures/rag/chemistry_basics.pdf). Each query searches only its own course. 'relevant' = every page that answers the question; 'required' = pages that must all be retrieved (multi-page and conflicting cases). Pages verified by reading scripts/make-rag-fixtures.ts and data/statistics_module_4_synthetic_notes.txt. Written by the developer, not an independent reviewer.
